kultivator.langit.peristiwa.source: Source: Zuo Zhuan, Duke Zhuang year 7: at midnight the stars fell like rain, the oldest record of a meteor shower; the Chinese folk belief that Tiangou, the Heavenly Dog, swallows the moon during an eclipse; Huainanzi ch. 8 (Ben Jing): ten suns rose together in the age of Yao. The twin moons and every game effect are game design.
kultivator.langit.harta.inspired: Inspired by the births of treasures in xianxia, marked by light piercing the sky and fought over by many cultivators, like the struggle for the Heavenly Flames in Battle Through the Heavens. The seven-colour rainbow pillar, the guardians and the numbers are game design.
kultivator.langit.cuaca.source: Source: Zhuangzi ch. 2 (Qi Wu Lun): the breath the Great Clod exhales is called the wind; Liexian Zhuan: Yin Xi, keeper of the pass, saw purple qi coming from the east before Laozi arrived. The Qi mists and their bonuses are game design.

kultivator.screen.help.peristiwa_langit: Every dusk in the Overworld and Alam Abadi the sky may give an omen (25%% chance, at the earliest 3 nights after the last event). Spirit Meteor Shower: falling stars pour from one point of the sky, fireballs now and then burst, and spirit meteors land 24-96 blocks from cultivators under the open sky (at most 6 per night); pick up the Spirit Meteor Stone each leaves (sneak + use: 150 Qi). Once every shower night a Great Meteor falls too, announced with its direction and distance: its crater glows for a minute and holds 3-5 Spirit Meteor Stones and one Great Meteor Heart (600 Qi and Space Dao comprehension +1). Blood Eclipse: the Heavenly Dog bites the moon bit by bit until it is all red, then gives it back towards dawn; monsters born near players may be Eclipse-Touched (+25%% health and attack, a red glow) and sometimes (35%%) leave an Eclipse Crystal (Shadow Dao comprehension +0.3, five a day); Shadow Dao meditation ×1.3; demon prison seals weaken. Twin Moons: a second silver moon rises, the full-moon site counts all night, Ice and Shadow Dao comprehension ×1.5, spirit beasts gain ×1.5 spirit XP. Near a demon prison whose seal is down to 30 or less, the sky turns an ashen red as an omen. Sleeping through the night ends the event; vanilla weather and time are never changed.
kultivator.screen.help.harta_lahir.title: Treasure Births
kultivator.screen.help.harta_lahir: About every three days a treasure is born 300-900 blocks from a cultivator: the ground trembles for 30 seconds, then a seven-colour Rainbow Pillar pierces the sky, visible from far away; near its end the light falters. The treasure floats on a jade lotus and only appears while a player is within 64 blocks. Sometimes (40%%) its guardians awaken: elite beasts titled Guardian, two from Heavenly Treasures up; while they live within 16 blocks the lotus is sealed. Right-click it, then stay within 2 blocks for 5 seconds to absorb it; a hit or stepping away breaks the absorption. Its tier follows the strongest cultivator nearby: Mortal Treasure (herbs of 100-300 years, mid spirit stones), Spirit Treasure (herbs of 500-1000 years, a high core, a jade slip), Heavenly Treasure (a millennium herb, a king core, a heavenly flame seed at 5%%), Immortal Treasure (Immortal Origin Stones, an essence pearl, a primordial material at 5%%); sometimes the sky adds Spirit Dew, Spirit Meteor Stones or a Great Meteor Heart. Rival cultivators want it too. The pillar fades after 10 minutes.
kultivator.screen.help.cuaca_roh.title: Spirit Weather
kultivator.screen.help.cuaca_roh: The world is split into 512-block regions whose spirit weather changes every 5 minutes, apart from ordinary rain. Clear (70%%), Thin Qi Mist (20%%, meditation site ×1.2), Dense Qi Mist (7%%, ×1.5) and Purple Dawn (3%%, only at dawn, ×1.6; facing east doubles the enlightenment chance, and purple Qi is seen streaming from the eastern horizon). Swamps, forests, taiga, jungles, cherry groves and mountains are mistier; deserts, badlands and savannas clearer. The mist takes the colour of the biome: pink in cherry groves, green in swamps, blue-white in snow, gold in Alam Abadi; by day in dense mist, sunbeams break through it. The bonus only counts under the open sky and stays under the meditation multiplier cap. From Nascent Soul on, the divine sense feels a mist come or go about 30 seconds before it does. During Dense Qi Mist or Purple Dawn, sneak + use an empty bottle to catch Spirit Dew (4 per day): drink it for Qi regeneration +20%% for 5 minutes.

kultivator.langit.sense.meteor_shower.1: At your realm one Spirit Meteor Stone is worth days of gathering Qi. Chase the falling lights.
kultivator.langit.sense.meteor_shower.2: Your divine sense catches the space torn in each star's wake. If the Great Meteor comes down, its heart teaches the Dao of Space.
kultivator.langit.sense.meteor_shower.3: To you falling stars are pebbles; what matters tonight is the Great Meteor and the Space Dao insight in its heart.
kultivator.langit.sense.meteor_shower.4: You have walked among the stars. Tonight the stars come down to meet you.
kultivator.langit.sense.blood_eclipse.1: Your blood runs cold. At your realm the Eclipse-Touched are deadly: stay near light and shelter.
kultivator.langit.sense.blood_eclipse.2: The shadows thicken. The Eclipse-Touched are a fitting trial, and the Eclipse Crystals they leave teach the Dao of Shadow.
kultivator.langit.sense.blood_eclipse.3: The Heavenly Dog bites the moon and the old seals creak. Demon prisons weaken tonight.
kultivator.langit.sense.blood_eclipse.4: To an Immortal an eclipse is a passing shadow. But the seals of the mortal world are not as strong as you.
kultivator.langit.sense.twin_moons.1: The silver light doubles. A good night to meditate under the open sky and calm the heart.
kultivator.langit.sense.twin_moons.2: The spirit beasts at your side grow faster tonight: every kill gives them ×1.5 spirit XP.
kultivator.langit.sense.twin_moons.3: Two moons mirror the Dao of Ice and Shadow. Meditate under the open sky; your insight flows faster.
kultivator.langit.sense.twin_moons.4: The second moon shines like the sky of Alam Abadi. Even for you, Ice and Shadow Dao insight flows faster tonight.
kultivator.langit.harta.above: The aura of the %s presses on your chest: this treasure is above your realm, and so are its guardians.
